tasks.short: Plan and supervise experiential learning activities

steps.what: Plan class projects, trips and guest visits around learning and safety needs
Arrange activity dates, staffing, bookings and required permissions
Supervise experiential activities and guide children in learning from them

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} and {WORKFLOW} activity checklists to reuse agreed dates, staffing and permission references. Keep educational planning, risk judgement, final arrangement checks and all supervision with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity details are copied between bookings, reminders and school checklists.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed activity forms and templates can reuse confirmed details.
tasks.still_hard: Permissions and staffing must be current, and children need live supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Turn a safe experience into useful learning while responding to the group.
tasks.altitude: Less logistics correspondence; educational and safety responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm safe trip and visitor arrangements

evidence.claim: Native activity forms and templates can reduce repeated logistics entry; this is E1 model knowledge without a measured digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher planning, arrangements and supervision, excluding transport provision, parent consent work and activity-provider labour.

The teacher produces activity ID, date, location, group, required staff and equipment constraints in s1 and retained s2 time. School administrators produce existing permission references and expiry status; the teacher checks them in s2, whose ten hours remain for capture, exceptions and confirmation.
No new parent data-entry process is introduced. Missing permission or staffing prevents confirmation and returns to manual coordination; no model infers consent.
Test native school activity checklists and booking tools before custom code. Additional checklist maintenance is counted below.
unknowns: Existing permission records and booking support
research_questions: Can a parallel activity plan reduce copying after counting permission checks and exception coordination?

already_counted.description: Activity planning and arrangement capture, checks and confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain activity templates and investigate workflow faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact activity, date, participants, staffing, booking and checked permission references; changes require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+10+50=90; gross 10%, minus three focal upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes four logistics hours removable; planning and all supervision remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan assignments and supervise classroom helpers

steps.what: Plan suitable assignments for teacher assistants and volunteers
Supervise helpers as they carry out the assigned activities
Evaluate helper performance and discuss practical improvements

tasks.design: Keep helper assignments, observation and feedback with the teacher. Existing guidance in {DOCS} supports role boundaries; no automated helper evaluation or new roster system is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful assignments depend on the helper's actual capability and classroom circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance already supports human supervision.
tasks.still_hard: A helper may need support that cannot be anticipated from an availability list.
tasks.human_edge: Give clear direction, notice difficulties and provide constructive feedback.
tasks.altitude: Supervision and assignment responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare helpers for appropriate classroom roles

evidence.claim: Direct helper supervision and feedback retain their labour without an invented scheduling baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's assignment, supervision and feedback effort, excluding helpers' labour and recruitment checks.
No new structured helper-performance or child-response score is required.
Existing native guidance suffices. No new deployment or maintenance is added, justifying zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Helper roles and local supervision requirements
research_questions: Are helper assignments understood and appropriate to each person's preparation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, zero gross and net saving. Live supervision and evaluation are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Involve volunteers and older students in focused play

steps.what: Explain focused play activities to parent volunteers and older students
Guide helpers' involvement in children's focused and complex play

tasks.design: Keep play-specific helper briefing and live guidance with the teacher. Existing activity references in {DOCS} support the process without introducing automated coordination or replacing adult participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Focused play requires helpers to respond to children's developing ideas.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change removes that responsive facilitation.
tasks.still_hard: An adult can unintentionally take over the play rather than extend it.
tasks.human_edge: Help volunteers support children's initiative while enriching the activity.
tasks.altitude: Play facilitation time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Develop effective adult participation in complex play

evidence.claim: Responsive helper involvement in play remains human work, with no software saving assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is play-specific briefing and facilitation. General helper assignments and performance evaluation belong to task 6524; a roll-up assigns any shared supervision episode once rather than adding it twice.
No new structured play-complexity or participation flag is introduced.
Existing native activity references suffice. No new deployment or ongoing maintenance is added, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Helper experience and selected play activities
research_questions: Do helpers extend children's ideas without directing all of the play?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Helper briefing and live play guidance remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer standardised tests and interpret results

steps.what: Administer standardized ability and achievement tests under the required conditions
Calculate test scores using the specified scoring key and norm tables
Interpret results alongside observations to determine developmental needs

tasks.design: Use authorised deterministic scoring in {OTHER}, the test publisher's scoring application, where the exact test version is supported. The teacher retains administration, response capture, score checks and developmental interpretation; the tool does not assign a placement or support decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic and norm-table lookups repeat fixed scoring rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Native publisher scoring can apply the authorised key and norms consistently.
tasks.still_hard: A valid score may be misleading when administration conditions or developmental context differ.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret the result with observations and recognise when specialist input is required.
tasks.altitude: Less score calculation; testing and interpretation responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Authorised fixed scoring keys and norm lookups can reduce arithmetic; support for the school's actual test and the saving are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher administration, scoring and interpretation, excluding test development and specialist assessment. No model evaluates the child's responses or developmental level.

The teacher produces child ID, test version, administration date, age reference, item responses and administration deviations in s1, whose 55 hours remain. Transfer into the scoring application and checking the applicable norm band occupy part of six retained s2 hours; no structured-response capture is free.

The publisher supplies the exact authorised scoring key and norm version. Unsupported versions, free responses requiring professional scoring or invalid conditions return to manual scoring within s2; reduce savings if this is common.
Test native publisher scoring first and do not recreate restricted norms in custom code. All developmental interpretation remains in s3.
unknowns: Actual tests, scoring permissions and native application support
research_questions: Can a parallel scoring trial reproduce authorised scores after counting response transfer and norm-version checks?

already_counted.description: Response capture, score transfer and checks, and developmental interpretation

incremental.description: Check test versions and scoring exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact child, test version, checked scores, administration context and developmental interpretation; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+6+30=91; gross 9%, minus two upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes three arithmetic hours removable where responses need manual scoring; administration and interpretation remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated activity logistics and supported test arithmetic while retaining supervision, play facilitation and developmental judgement.
reach: Work with assessment specialists on appropriate score interpretation
role.ambitious_version: A kindergarten teacher who spends less time copying logistics and calculating scores while keeping responsibility for children and helpers.
